diffs.diff: header pin 6 (CTRL): part says gnd, datasheet reading says nc
diffs.evidence: The T6713 data sheet lists pin 6 as 'No Connect / Ground / 10k pull down to' select the interface, and the T67xx application note says left open selects UART while for 'I2C & 25 KHZ PWM' 'Pin 6 is grounded by the user', so this I2C model correctly ties CTRL to GND (nc would leave the sensor in UART mode).
